The Melanie Perkins Story as Canva CEO - KITRUM
## Why is Canva so successful?

Melanie Perkins is certain that Canva’s success is the result of a carefully crafted strategy and years of dedicated effort. One of the platform’s biggest strengths is its 165 million passionate users, who act as advocates, spreading the word to their friends, colleagues, and family. This organic growth has been a driving force behind Canva’s rapid acceleration. [...] Melanie Perkin was born in Perth, Australia, in 1987. In Melanie Perkins’s childhood, she was passionate about figure skating and would normally wake up at 4:30 a.m. every day for training. Engaging in sports instilled in her a mindset of setting and striving for goals and cultivating an ambitious attitude.

At the age of 14, she started her first business selling handmade scarves at markets and shops throughout Perth, which she considers to have developed her entrepreneurial drive. [...] Melanie Perkins reflects on this period, stating, “Those two years were probably the least fun, but they set the groundwork for everything we are able to do today.” By prioritizing back-end development, Canva introduced features like simultaneous collaboration, improved interoperability, and scalable infrastructure, which now support a development team of over 2,000 engineers.
